LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.2: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Performing and Displaying in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How can a good tone be produced on a descant recorder?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  observe and interpret the baroque fingering chart of the notes C D E F G A B C’ C to D1

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  observe and interpret the baroque fingering chart of the notes C D E F G A B C’ C to D1

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Descant Recorder together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Learning to learn: The learner will take the initiative to learn how to play notes and melodies on the descant recorder.

 Citizenship: developed through playing the main melody of the Kenya National Anthem on the descant recorder.

Values:
 Responsibility - will be nurtured as they observe safety and hygiene measures in the use of the descant recorders.

 Respect: is instilled through use of respectful words as they appreciate and appraise each other’s performances using polite

language.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

 Peer education and mentorship: The learner contributes to others’ work through appraising it and providing feedback for

improvement.

 Health issues in Education: communicable diseases- observance of hygiene measures in the use of the descant recorder in

order to prevent transmission of communicable diseases.
